statement_summary: Qualified Individual designated in writing; rules if the role moves to a provider
Written risk assessment every August and after major changes (SP 800-30)
Risk acceptance authority; High risks never accepted; payment and family-privacy appetite statements
Sanctions recorded; good-faith reporting protected
Service providers vetted, bound by contract, listed, and reviewed yearly
Annual independent assessment; monthly vulnerability scans with 14-day fixes; program adjusted
Annual written report to the Board of Managers (voluntary)
Annual policy review; policies available to all staff
Exceptions in writing, risk-rated, time-limited; Qualified Individual approves MFA and encryption exceptions
Investment advice only to family clients; written eligibility check
Unique accounts for staff, guests, MSP technicians, and family users; shared MSP admin account replaced
Least privilege and need to know by family branch and subsidiary; written approval
MFA for everyone; security keys for staff and administrators; no SMS for staff; SYS-11 only through MFA gateway
At most two standing global administrators; other admin rights just in time
Offboarding checklist on the last day, including tokens and guests; subsidiaries report guest departures in 1 business day
Monthly account reconciliation; 180-day guest expiry; quarterly access review
10-minute laptop lock; app protection policy on personal phones
Named MSP and vendor accounts with MFA; technician list; changes approved in the ticket
Passwords of 12+ characters in a password manager; Wi-Fi password changed yearly and at departures
Callback at a number on file for new payees, bank-detail changes, and wires over $10,000; payment log; second-person check
SYS-02 alerts routed to the MSP and Family Office Director; monthly log review; one-year retention
Office systems for office work; open only needed information
No office information in personal accounts or unapproved AI tools
Lock screens; never share passwords, keys, tokens, or codes
Training at hire and yearly with the payment-fraud module; phishing simulations
Report suspected incidents and unusual payment requests at once
No public description of the office as an adviser to outsiders
Signed acknowledgment at hire and after updates
Runbook for tenant compromise with payment fraud; printed copies and contact card
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour
Suspected payment fraud: bank recall first, then IC3 complaint
Incident and near-miss log
Breach and notification-event decision with counsel; record the determination date
Notices per the P08 matrix; written no-notice determination kept 5 years and sent to the Department
Insurer hotline before hiring outside firms; MSP engaged under contract
No ransom without Principal approval, counsel, insurer, and OFAC check
Subsidiaries, MSP, and vendors report incidents; office tells affected subsidiaries within 24 hours
Annual tabletop with the MSP
Lessons learned within 30 days; weaknesses get owners and dates
Three levels: Restricted, Internal, Public
Encrypt Restricted information at rest and in transit; compensating controls approved in writing
Restricted family documents only in the vault; working copies deleted in 30 days; expiring share links
Data inventory of Restricted information
Retention schedule; disposal within two years of last use unless an exception applies; disposal log
New-tool checklist and approved-tools list, including AI
Independent SYS-02 backup; SYS-11 snapshots in a separate account; quarterly restore tests
